name_reason: Compliant: data_fd2_ prefix (game global) + graphics domain (defined in src/gfx/rndscene.c, used by the char-sprite paint routine) + descriptive 'char_sprite_paint_jitter_tick_latch'. The name correctly conveys a scalar value-holder ('latch'/'tick'). 'tick' = BIOS timer tick (domain concept at BDA 0x46C), not a Ghidra address residue; no hex suffix matching 0x53a08 or any data address. Reflects the data type (a tick-value latch).
purpose: Edge-detect latch holding the last BIOS tick value that drove a toggle of the sleeping-character sprite shake-jitter bit, so the jitter flips at most once per BIOS tick.
logic_summary: Read+written only by fd2_paint_char_sprite_at_world_pos (@0x127E0). On entry it loads the 16-bit BIOS tick counter at 0x46C sign-extended to int32 (MOVSX EAX,word[0x46C]); if that differs from this latch (CMP EAX,[0x53A08]), it flips the 1-byte sibling shake-jitter bit at 0x53A04 (XOR byte[0x53A04],1) and stores the new tick into this latch (MOV [0x53A08],EAX). The jitter bit (0/1) is later added to the sprite blit_offset when the painted char has the sleep status, giving a +0/+1 pixel shake alternating once per tick.
element_semantics: Single signed 32-bit scalar: a sign-extended copy of the 16-bit BIOS tick counter (BDA 0x46C). Full-width dword access (CMP/MOV on the whole dword). Value range is the sign-extended 16-bit tick (-0x8000..0x7FFF).
